scripts.dev: rm -rf node_modules/.vite && node scripts/sync-public.mjs && astro dev
scripts.dev:clean: rm -rf node_modules/.vite .astro dist && node scripts/sync-public.mjs && astro dev
scripts.preview: npm run build && wrangler dev --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:pages-redirect: wrangler pages deploy pages-redirect --project-name fashion-freelancing --branch main
